title: Being Difficult After Endangering Child Safety
description:
Officers conducted a traffic stop as they observed a small child moving freely in the back seat of a car and it was apparent that the child had no restraint. The mother was charged with obstructing law enforcement and the grandmother was issued a few traffic citations and was arrested for pending warrants.
